title: Living with Skin and Lung Cancer : Understanding the patient experience in Europe, the UK and Canada
summary: This qualitative, non-interventional, multinational online observational study aims to gain a deeper understanding of the lived experiences, unmet needs, and challenges of people with  Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma (cSCC) and Non-Small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC). This will be achieved through the analysis of online interviews and digital diaries in seven countries (Germany, Austria, France, Spain, Sweden, the United Kingdom, and Canada). This study registration applies only to the part of the study conducted in Germany.
conditions: Malignant neoplasm of bronchus and lung

interventions.name:
This is a qualitative, non-interventional behavioral study involving 24 patients and 3–4 physicians in Germany.
In Arm 1, 2- to 6-hour online interviews are conducted with up to 10 patients. In addition, after the interview, these patients keep a digital diary (approx. 4 hours) over a period of 14
In Arm 2, 14 additional patients keep only a digital diary (approximately 4 hours) over a period of 14 days.

In Arm 3, 1 hour online interviews will be conducted with 3-4 physicians who specialize in cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (cSCC) or non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC), or who treat patients with these conditions, in order to gain insights into treatment practices in Germany.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
18 years or older
Active diagnosis of cSCC or NSCLC (for patients) 
Access to a smartphone/tablet and basic digital literacy (for patients)
Treatment of patients with cSCC or NSCLC (for healthcare professionals)  
Able to provide informed consent
Exclusion criteria:
Under 18 years old
In remission
Employed by/affiliated with a pharmaceutical company
Unable to provide informed consent
No access to a smartphone or tablet
